metadata.title: List of Clan Gods and Villages in Dantewada

pens.name: Punga Rungi
pens.notes: Telam wife, married to Mai Sunga Kunjam pen husband, now ghar jamai in Bhansi

pens.name: Urru Mara (Huru Mara)
pens.notes: Mawe Lungo is d/o Nandraj and Mawli. Also cross-referenced in Table 0 (Kunjam phratry). Gudi in Omalwar with Urru Dokri. Palli: Jhirka, Dokometta, Dhanora, Tumnar, Bhansi.

pens.name: Lug Unga
pens.notes: s/o Huru Mara and Mawe Lungo

pens.name: Mai Sunga
pens.notes: Ghar jamai, married to Punga Rungi d/o Huru Mara and Urru Dokri. Has his palli and dhaniya in Jaraloha.

pens.name: Palenda
pens.notes: s/o Handa Kosa

pens.name: Handa (Andal) Kosa
pens.notes: Married to Pal Hadme, d/o Hirma Raj of Markamiras

pens.name: Vedmo Moitor
pens.notes: Younger brother of Urru Moitor

pens.name: Hunga Moitor
pens.notes: At the Cholnar karsad there was also Budi Moyo who had come with Hunga Moitor

pens.name: Gal Dullo
pens.notes: Child of Gaddi Kama

pens.name: Gal Bomda
pens.notes: Child of Gaddi Kama

pens.name: (unnamed son of Punga Rungi and Mai Sunga)
pens.notes: Name not given in source

pens.name: Chichur Unga
pens.notes: Bachelor. To get married to Pal Urre, d/o Andal Kosa Madvi pen of Cholnar

pens.name: Babo Harma Pen
pens.notes: Source: Grigson

pens.name: Godar Hunga
pens.notes: s/o Huru Mara and Katte Bodke. See case study of Jhirka on phallis.

pens.name: Markaraj (Marka Moitor)
pens.notes: Palli: Dantewada jail, Markanar, Kumharras, Matenar, Kondoli (son lives), Gamawada (son also called Markaraj), Ganjenar (son/bro), Mulasnar (Gumorongo s/o Markaraj), Balod, Kuper (chud inga, bro), Veesro, Kundundel

pens.name: Hadma Iriyal
pens.notes: Brother of Gaddi Kama

pens.name: Vidi Iriyal Panda Hadma
pens.notes: Third and youngest unmarried brother of Gaddi Kama

pens.name: (unnamed pen)
pens.notes: Either a son of Punga Rungi & Mai Sunga or a son of Urru Moitor

pens.name: Hadma Raj
pens.notes: s/o Urru Moitor (same pen as Palnar)

pens.name: Bhum Iriyal
pens.notes: His daughter Kohli Dokri is married to Gaddi Kama, Oyam Pen of Pandewar

pens.name: Bhimaraj
pens.notes: Brothers of Huru Mara of Bhansi (needs clarification)

pens.name: Biriya Bhima
pens.notes: Mudde Dokri is d/o Muddaraj. Biriya Bhima, Mudde Dokri and Urru Ponde counted as Chote Telam. Bhogams also known as Chote Telams.

pens.name: Godar Bhima
pens.notes: Chaikut = small, Godar = one who crossed Godavari. Son across Godavari; daughter Inge Dokri has pen in Kuper. Palli: Palnar, Teknar, Chitalur, Kawalnar, Mangnar, Midkulnar, bits of Pharaspal, Kesapur, Turparas, Idodpara. Offerings at Diwad and Bijja Pandum.

pens.name: Iram Raj
pens.notes: Also called Irma Raj

pens.name: Kohla Kosu
pens.notes: s/o Raibandal

pens.name: Bomul Ungal
pens.notes: s/o Biriya Bhima

pens.name: Urru Moitor
pens.notes: Gudi in Omalwar. Urru Moitor and Urru Dokri have their gudi in Omalwar

pens.name: Perambhoi Raj
pens.notes: Younger brother of Urru Moitor

pens.name: Gaddi Kama
pens.notes: Also written as Ghadi Kama. Children with Murke Nango: Gal Dullo (Etlapad), Gal Bomda (Etlapad), Hingal Devo (Korre Kongdam), 1 more boy. With Kohli Dokri: Chenna Kama, Ghanta Kama, Ukud Kama (all in Pandewar). Murke Nango is d/o Huru Mara of Bhansi. Kohli Dokri is d/o Bhum Iriya (Kadti pen, Madadi).

pens.name: Gujje Dokri
pens.notes: Made of irirom mada in Songunda above Kondanpal. Married to Hunga Moitor in Dugeli. Visit each other at karsads.

pens.name: Bande Boyo
pens.notes: May or may not be brother of Gaddi Kama

pens.name: Vange (Vunge) Dokri
pens.notes: Married to Nanga Bhima in Gangalur village

pens.name: Chudanda
pens.notes: Younger brother of Handa Kosa

pens.name: Bade Vidi Iriyal
pens.notes: Second brother of Gaddi Kama. No sisters.

pens.name: Daro Moitor (Darrem Modka)
pens.notes: Elder brother of Huru Mara of Bhansi. Palli: Chandenar, Renganar.

pens.name: Kundel Ganga
pens.notes: Also called Jalsingo. Brother of Hadma Raj, s/o Urru Moitor

pens.name: Gariaram
pens.notes: Younger brother of Chichur Unga

pens.name: Muddaraj
pens.notes: Father of Mudde Dokri who is married to Biriya Bhima (Chote Telam) of Madpal. Phalli extends to Madpal.

narrative_sources.text: The Kunjams brought all the pen from Daler and then distributed them to all the different clans at Nandraj mountain.

facts.subject: kunjam
facts.details: Brought pens from Daler, distributed at Nandraj mountain

narrative_sources.text: Hura Mara, Bhim Iriya, Daro Modka, Bhimaraj and Godar Bhima are all brothers.
Biriya Bhima was originally from Mangnar, and is married to Mudde Dokri, the daughter of Muddaraj
Dol Mutte was pregnant... gave birth to Bhogam

facts.details: Dol Mutte gave birth to Bhogam, child of Bhimaraj

facts.subject: bhogam
facts.details: Bhogams are also known as Chote Telams

narrative_sources.text: Huru Mara, elder wife Urru Dokri, second wife Mawe Lungo (daughter of Nandraj and Mawli)
Punga Rungi is daughter of Huru Mara and Urru Dokri; Lug Unga is son of Huru Mara and Mawe Lungo
Mai Sunga married to Punga Rungi, ghar jamai in Bhansi
Godar Hunga, s/o Huru Mara and Katta Bodke (a third wife)
3 brothers: Andal Kosa (Madvi), Gaddi Kama (Oyam), Madkaraj (Barse)
Bros 2 & 3 (Bade Vidi and Vidi Iriyal) born in Pen Kokhra; Nos 4-6 born near Gangalur
Markaraj married to Hinge Dokri. Lingal Denga is brother. Hingal Dokri represented by iron ring.
Ural Gunda, biggest brother, left Hingal Dokri, then Markaraj brought her
